v4_delay_spacing.description: Two 20-tick delays must land about 40 ticks apart in total, not together. BUNDLE_END durationTicks should be near 40, not near 20.

v4_delay_end_is_last.description: BUNDLE_END must come after the final delayed command, never before it.

v4_delay_zero.description: An explicit zero delay must behave exactly like no delay. Duration should be about 0.

v4_nest_parent.description: Parent must park until the child finishes. Order must be parent_before, child_ran, parent_after.

v4_nest_delayed_child.description: A child that spans ticks must still block the parent. parent_AFTER must appear after the child's delayed mark.

v4_child_failure_counts_once.description: A failing child must count as exactly ONE failed command in the parent. Parent has stopOnFailure false so it continues.

v4_stop_on_failure_true.description: Must halt at the bad command. The mark after it must NOT appear, and stoppedEarly must be true.

v4_stop_on_failure_false.description: Must run past the bad command. Both marks must appear and failed must be 1.

v4_cycle_a.description: Calls b, which calls back into a. The cycle must be refused explicitly, with no recursion and no crash.

v4_self_cycle.description: A bundle that calls itself. The simplest cycle, must be refused.

v4_empty.description: An empty command list is legal. It must still emit a matching BUNDLE_START and BUNDLE_END pair.
